title.headline: 2,000 licences a year, cleared same day.

end.line: Quillon for Everly Media’s rights team

vo: Everly Media’s rights team clears about two thousand licences a year. Here is that work in Quillon.
Ask one question across a whole matter, and Quillon reads every talent contract, in every territory, before it answers.
Vault reviews every licence at once, so territory and term restrictions come back flagged in one table.
When a producer emails for clearance, the reply is drafted in Outlook the same day, cited to the clause.
Daniel will walk your team through it on Tuesday the twenty-fourth.
